performance_case.causal_mechanism: A forward-only, decision-lagged crypto-carry source may expose derivatives-market crowding and constrained-arbitrage risk before a later BTC spot DRA entry, while preserving the existing entry, exit, capital, accounting and Trading boundaries.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may select only one raw source-atom design and its causal availability, isolation, missing-data and version boundaries. It cannot call a market endpoint, compute a feature, select an economic parameter, implement or activate capture, or establish prediction, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Only a later separately frozen forward experiment could show whether a causal carry-conditioned admission veto avoids adverse paths without excessive missed winners; this source-design audit leaves drawdown and false-veto cost MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Selecting one source contract before implementation prevents a convenient but causally late funding feed, unstable formula, incomplete futures inventory or duplicate timer from consuming implementation and forward-evidence time; closing both options is cheaper than collecting unusable data.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The selected raw source could enable a later preregistered test of fee-adjusted total PnL and drawdown improvement, but this design audit has zero immediate performance effect and makes no alpha claim.
